title: PinMAME spatial report envelope
description: Common envelope for every report under reports/spatial. Two report purposes exist and each has its own format identifier: an audit justifies a promotion and belongs to an author-ready machine, while a blocker report explains why a machine cannot yet be promoted and belongs to a partial or stub machine. Report bodies stay game-specific, so additional properties are deliberately permitted; only the envelope and the report's relationship to its machine are constrained here.

format.description: The report's purpose. An audit may only describe an author-ready machine; a blocker report may only describe a machine that is not author-ready.

machine_id.description: The machine this report describes. It must resolve to a definition under machines/.
